name: dsh-path-diagnostics
description: Read-only unique basename diagnostics for failed filesystem reads in DeepSeek Harness.

scripts.typecheck: tsc --pretty false --target ES2022 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --strict --noEmit --allowImportingTsExtensions --types node src/**/*.ts tests/**/*.test.ts
scripts.bundle: tsdown src/index.ts --dts --format esm --out-dir lib --clean && node --input-type=module -e "import { rename } from 'node:fs/promises'; await rename('lib/index.mjs', 'lib/index.js'); await rename('lib/index.d.mts', 'lib/index.d.ts');"
